original.text: OPEN - BLOCKS UNCONDITIONAL PASS. Root cause R1 (also B-01, C-01): intra-second fill order is an unresolved convention. No order chosen by the audit; measured sensitivity in M2F_METHODOLOGY_LIMITATIONS.md section 1. Requires a user decision.

amendments.text: R1 evidence refines the finding. The observed-layer dependence is real but narrow: under the approved sensitivity policies, 1-5 instruments, 1-12 episodes (ordinal-id definition; 1-7 by content) and 2-4 fills' open/close split change (sells_first 1/1/2, buys_first 5/12/4, trade_id and order_no 2/4/4, sensex_trade_id_time 0/0/0). Six populations are reported separately: (1) groups whose order differs: 29 / 29 / 173 / 141 / 21 of 4,464 multi-fill same-instrument-second groups; (2) groups that change open/close allocation: 1 / 2 / 2 / 2 / 0 (this also happens in SAME-SIDE groups: the two trade-id groups are NIFTY 2026-09-01 rows 27911/27917 and 27912/27916); (3) episode identity; (4) closing-batch membership (1-2 batches); (5) wing/body membership; (6) FIFO/LIFO lot attribution of closing fills (lot-sequence definition, equal to the reviewer's independent count; lot-set definition in brackets): FIFO 2 / 4 / 666 [654] / 598 [590] / 84 [81] and LIFO 65 / 74 / 662 [653] / 593 [588] / 80 [76] (sells_first / buys_first / trade_id / order_no / sensex_trade_id_time) of 17,760 closing fills. CORRECTION OF EVIDENCE: the first R1 document stated that NIFTY trade ids and order numbers are not time-monotone; that was an artefact of pooling across IST days and is WITHDRAWN. Per instrument and IST day, NIFTY trade ids have 0 inversions in 18,305 cross-second comparisons and SENSEX nanosecond ids 0 in 19,811; the file order contradicts them inside 172 groups (151 NIFTY, 21 SENSEX). The earlier statement that the trade id contradicts file order in only two mixed-side groups was incomplete. Disposition: SOURCE_ROW_ORDER_CONVENTION is a deterministic convention, NOT verified chronology, and the best available sub-second evidence partly contradicts it; the choice of primary convention is RE-PRESENTED to the project owner (reports/R1_TIE_ORDER_CONVENTION.md section 9). Disclosed, metadata stamped, sensitivities published. The ambiguity cannot be eliminated from the source data.

OWNER DECISION: Option C recorded. SOURCE_ROW_ORDER_CONVENTION stays primary; delivered outputs not regenerated; downstream research must evaluate both orderings; the hybrid scenario PER_CONTRACT_ID_SEQUENCE is implemented and compared in reports/R1C_DUAL_SCENARIO_COMPARISON.md (4 episodes / 2 instruments / 4 split fills / 1 batch per view / 6 W1-W2 links differ; totals stable). Neither ordering is verified chronology.

D-A01.current_state: REMEDIATED BY POLICY AND DISCLOSURE (R1, 2026-11-15): SOURCE_ROW_ORDER_CONVENTION approved as the primary deterministic convention; sensitivity-only policies added; convention stamped in four manifests; disclosure addenda appended; six populations reported separately. The ambiguity is not eliminated (whole-second timestamps). Independent R1 review done (14 findings; the HIGH one, a wrongly pooled NIFTY trade-id metric, corrected). Owner decision Option C (2026-11-15): baseline kept, both orderings evaluated downstream, dual-scenario comparison published. Disposition stays REMEDIATED BY POLICY AND DISCLOSURE (not closed); the dependence is a documented limitation handled by mandatory dual-scenario research; pending the final M2 acceptance decision.
